title: Long Script
description:
Code-style rule — scripts with more than 150 steps. Very long scripts are hard to read, test and reuse.

Based on the PMD rule ExcessiveMethodLength — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_design.html#excessivemethodlength Threshold adjustable via the header slider (default 150).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Long scripts concentrate too much responsibility in one place.
rule.remediation: Extract cohesive sections into sub-scripts with clear parameters.
